manual_checks: Signed or Play-delivered candidate validation on the exact release artifact
Authenticated EmbeddingGemma retrieval and later relevant-memory use
Jandal chat repair action that opens Android Settings for location, if product flow is added
Complete PTT/TTS response with a supported device voice
Second voice turn, background/resume, and audio-focus recovery observation
Final permission, crash, network/declaration, and Play Data Safety scan on the signed or Play artifact

cases.name: Fresh install to first useful action
cases.notes: Prior clean-install and launch evidence remains partial; this session did not repeat fresh-install work.

cases.name: Upgrade over an existing install
cases.notes: Non-destructive adb install -r preserved the populated fixture, E4B cache, seeded list/item, conversations, messages, memories, notes, and shortcuts. Force-stop/relaunch completed without a model re-download loop.

cases.name: Local chat and generation lifecycle
cases.notes: Cumulative evidence proves local E4B generation, Thinking/streaming UI, cancellation recovery, subsequent turn, background/resume, relaunch persistence, and focused crash/ANR absence.

cases.name: Memory
cases.notes: The candidate model and voice assets are present, but no EmbeddingGemma/SentencePiece assets were available. Retrieval was not attempted or substituted.

cases.name: Lists and notes
cases.notes: The exact named-list add_to_list route, existing-list mutation, complete/edit/remove flow, seeded fixture preservation, note CRUD/restart persistence, and genuine ambiguous-request clarification are proven.

cases.name: Alarm and timer reliability
cases.notes: A locked timer produced an audible alert, notification-only visual fallback, and normal dismissal. Full capability-repair/retry and remaining timer acceptance assertions are not proven.

cases.name: Weather and location fallback
failures: Chat weather repair flow did not open Android Settings
cases.notes: Denied chat weather truthfully returned a location capability-required result. The dialog offered Use my location, Use a named location, and Not now, but no Settings link. External Settings restoration and normal return produced a genuine local-weather result.

cases.name: Push-to-talk and spoken response
failures: Text-to-speech voice for en-AU is not available on this device
cases.notes: Voice capture and direct-reply routing completed, and audio capture/playback start-stop events were observed without a crash. The candidate surfaced a TTS voice-unavailable error after the post-repair Hey Jandal time command; second voice turn, background/resume, and approved #1447 voice quality remain unresolved.

cases.name: Permission revocation and repair
failures: Full microphone-plus-location repair contract not complete
cases.notes: Microphone revocation showed the accurate microphone-removed repair dialog; permission restoration returned to Jandal and restarted Hey safely. Location denial, external restore, return, and retry also worked, but the required app-directed Settings repair action was not available on chat weather.

cases.name: Hey Jandal lifecycle
cases.notes: Hey Jandal worked while Google remained the default assistant. Wake detection, microphone yield, and a useful time command worked; disable/service-stop was verified. After microphone revocation, the repair dialog appeared, microphone restoration restarted the service safely, and a post-repair spoken wake succeeded. The subsequent en-AU TTS voice-unavailable message is Journey 8 evidence and does not reduce this lifecycle result.
